status: Body/pose/gear planning records retained as history; seven physically unproduced sports cast overrides added under latest teacher steering. Root merges only still-unproduced records.
authority: Teacher delegated body/cast decisions. No teacher roster approval. Human-face direction remains unresolved; every body here stays nonhuman.
rules: Preserve all already-selected portraits and prior accepted artwork. This plan covers pending portraits only.
Species/art IDs, public-persona inspiration, colour/palette, frozen mechanics, rarity and acquisition are unchanged. displayPersona changes only the visible pun.

Keep one bold public-persona cue. Accessory diversity may replace generic books/cards/plans with fantasy tools, relics or instruments; preserve essential print jokes only as a small minority. Use affinity jewels and ART-BIBLE materials.
Pose is a still full-body composition, not a motion animation. Keep face and prop readable, with intact extremities and transparent outer padding.
No licensed costume/logo, copied lyrics, private-life joke, human likeness or new gameplay keyword.
Root owns exact prompt/provenance updates and canonical roster handoff.
Armour and weapons are presentation only. They never add attack, Guard, Shield, immunity, spell effects or sound requests; frozen contracts still control all play.

A few original animal/object hybrids may use surreal internet-meme energy: glider crocodile, mushroom puppet and loon balloon. Use original Rift forms, no copied meme art, phrases, logos or voices. Hybrid parts confer no gameplay ability.

rows.bodyBrief: A friendly silver-edged scorpion with broad warm animal eyes, dark segmented shell and simple silver-trimmed sports wraps. Eight small walking legs, two broad pincers and one curved tail with a blunt stylized tip; no human arms. One plain handball held in a pincer.
rows.poseBrief: PRIMARY LEFT: low forward throwing step, body and pincers clearly face left, tail curls upward and back to the right. One pincer raises the ball above the shoulder line; whole tail and all legs fit.
rows.shortRationale: A Danish handball role answers the class preference; the scorpion throw is an original nonhuman sporting gag, not a human likeness.
rows.accessoryBrief: One compact silver-and-cream handball with broad plain panels; no branded kit, number, net or second prop.
rows.gearRationale: Frozen3/4 timing-support body: natural shell and modest sport wraps convey sturdy tempo play. Tail is cosmetic, adding no poison, damage, Guard or extra scheduling.
rows.sourceScope: Official sporting-role evidence only; no current club, award, injury, private-life or class-recognition claim.

rows.bodyBrief: Lively newt with dark tufts, animal eyes and silver-collared jacket over a light chest guard; one plain clapper.
rows.poseBrief: Right-facing high step, clapper raised and head looking back over a shoulder.
rows.shortRationale: Retain an amphibian actor with a clear returning-for-one-more-scene gesture.
rows.accessoryBrief: One blank bronze-hinged film clapper; no franchise insignia or written title.
rows.gearRationale: 3/4 allows a light silver chest guard under stage clothes. Gear adds no resurrection or bonus beyond the frozen return effect.

rows.bodyBrief: Small cuttlefish with pointed head fins, delighted animal eyes and a silver scarf over a compact bronze mantle collar. One blank pocket-watch reliquary is held by two close arms; no blue box.
rows.poseBrief: Left-facing hovering S-curve, watch held toward the viewer and remaining arms swept compactly backward.
rows.shortRationale: A curious tentacled storyteller keeps a strong pun and a soft streamlined silhouette distinct from Adam's broad octopus.
rows.accessoryBrief: One oversized open brass pocket-watch case with a blank dial and a simple silver rim; no written numerals or licensed device.
rows.gearRationale: 3/7 is sturdy support: a small bronze-and-silver mantle collar suits the bulk. Watch and armour add no automatic healing, Shield or Fate ability.

rows.bodyBrief: Scholarly tapir with short snout, dark coat and modest silver shoulder armour; one linked-loop staff.
rows.poseBrief: Front-facing seated brace, staff held diagonally and short snout turned toward its linked rings.
rows.shortRationale: Keep the uncommon tapir and symmetry prop; its compact snout/body differ from the existing elephant.
rows.accessoryBrief: One broad silver-linked-loop staff, two simple rings sharing a single shaft; no slate or algebra.
rows.gearRationale: 4/7 supports modest silver shoulder armour and a large scholarly focus. The loop staff does not create extra replay or refund energy.

accessoryPolicy: Fantasy tools, relics, instruments, armour and occasional magical weapons; one bold prop. Gear is purely artistic and never adds a gameplay keyword. Only essential minority print props survive.
